reviewer_role: Separate Codex AI reviewer; advisory review, not an independent human assessor or grade guarantee
scope: Review of audit_overfitting.py and saved diagnostic artifacts; independent numerical checks without training or new model inference

checks_performed.check: Recomputed macro-F1 and accuracy from all clean train/validation prediction CSVs using sklearn
Checked row counts, duplicate identifiers and recorded losses against diagnostic metrics files
checks_performed.limitation: Loss values were compared to recorded measurements, not independently recomputed through model inference.

checks_performed.check: Verified all six checkpoint gap rows by subtracting independently checked split macro-F1 values
Verified frozen and partial summary mean macro-F1 values and mean training-validation/training-test gaps
Compared history diagnostics to original history.json, including selected/final loss, final F1 deterioration, later-epoch counts and augmented-training-loss changes
Verified clean validation identifiers, labels and predicted labels exactly equal the original selected-checkpoint validation outputs
Verified reused test metric dictionaries exactly equal original metrics_test.json files
Verified diagnostic checkpoint hash references against original protocol lock entries and existing test records
Recomputed protocol-lock, audit_overfitting.py source and original experiment.py source SHA256 values and checked recorded values

interpretation: The fixed selected partial checkpoints show small observed mean clean training-validation and training-test macro-F1 gaps on this dataset.

Partial seed 42 deteriorates after its selected epoch despite lower final augmented training loss, consistent with some overfitting or instability; the earlier validation-selected checkpoint was retained.
Validation was used for checkpoint selection, so its performance is optimistic as an estimate of independent generalisation.
Small observed gaps do not prove absence of overfitting, leakage, dependence or distribution shift.
Original test results and training-source hash remain unchanged; this supplementary diagnostic is post-hoc and does not select a replacement model.

rubric_review.dataset_and_preprocessing_15_percent: Substantial executed evidence: provenance, original split, counts, integrity/duplicate audit, normalization and matched augmentation; farm/plant independence remains unverified.
rubric_review.model_and_implementation_25_percent: Substantial executed evidence: suitable advanced ViT, genuine partial fine-tuning, paired controls and implementation checks; DINOv2 is established rather than current state of the art, leaving the overview wording subject to assessor interpretation.
rubric_review.evaluation_20_percent: Substantial executed evidence: six paired runs, multiple metrics, per-class errors, confidence interval, costs and all-six-checkpoint post-hoc overfitting diagnostic; small fixed test and validation reuse limit inference.
rubric_review.ethics_20_percent: Covered with measured error consequences, limited disease/geographic coverage, confidence limitations, fairness/access caveats, attribution and human oversight.
rubric_review.report_20_percent: Reviewed report sources previously contained supported claims, references and a compliant word budget; this file does not certify subsequent rendering or edits.
rubric_review.overall: All five weighted areas have substantial supporting evidence; this is not a guarantee that every assessor interpretation or a particular grade is satisfied.

remaining_caveats: Student understanding, authorship/AI-assistance review and final submission remain the student responsibilities.
The private GitHub repository must be accessible to the assessor through the approved submission route; Moodle submission is not established by this review.
Colab execution and a slide deck are not explicit requirements in the supplied original brief; unexecuted Colab reproduction is a portability limitation, not itself a missing rubric item.
No current-state-of-the-art or field-deployment superiority claim is established.
Diagnostic reproducibility requires retaining or regenerating the original selected checkpoints; this review does not modify training or test evidence.
